limitations: Historical audit exposes actor ID/name/reason, not a historical role snapshot.
Owner-directed automated decisions are not independent human examination.
Evidence and solution prose remain in Minx; this ledger binds IDs and content hashes without copying transcripts.
Development links retain user-supplied/unverified observations; this audit does not refetch all old GitHub artifacts.
All historical runtime results remain bound to their original sources, not rerun by parent closeout.
